listing.title: My First Tools Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Tool Pages – Hammer, Wrench, Toolbox & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly tools!

Little hands color 30 tool pictures, from a hammer, a screwdriver and a wrench to a toolbox, a hard hat and a traffic cone. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a smiling face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Hand tools: Hammer, Screwdriver, Wrench, Pliers, Saw, Mallet and Clamp
  • Measuring and marking: Tape Measure, Level, Ruler and Pencil
  • Fix-it things: Drill, Toolbox, Paint Roller, Ladder, Light Bulb, Magnet, Nails, Nut & Bolt and Tape
  • Safety gear: Hard Hat, Safety Goggles, Work Gloves, Tool Belt and Traffic Cone
  • Workshop and yard: Workbench, Sawhorse, Rake, Shovel and Bucket
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5 who love to build, fix and pretend.

Part of the my first step series.
